## DPDP Compliance Management Software for India — https://veridian-aios.com/

DPDP Act 2023 · DPDP Rules 2025
### Compliance that outlasts the person who set it up.
VERIDIAN turns the law into a list of jobs, hands each one to a named person, and keeps a dated record that nobody can edit.

Why it matters
### Three things to know about DPDP compliance
1. People change. When they leave, what they knew about your data leaves with them.
2. Know what data you hold, and who else holds it for you.
3. Prove it — with a record that outlasts the person who set it up.
How it works
### From the law to a record, in four plain steps.
### The law becomes jobs
Each obligation turns into a clear job, mapped to the section or rule it comes from.
### Each job gets one owner
The job goes to the responsible person. Owners, staff, vendors and group companies are all covered.
### One email a week
Everyone answers through one email a week, with no accounts or passwords.
### The record builds itself
Each answer is recorded with a date and cannot be edited, building the proof an organisation needs.
### Your free DPDP AI assistant
It does the routine work. You stay in charge.
Open your personal link in your own AI. It reads your jobs and drafts the updates. You confirm them.
Get your free AI assistant See how it works
What is overdue this week?
Two jobs. The privacy notice is waiting on the Principal, and the vendor list needs one more answer. Draft ready for your review.
Update the vendor list.
Drafted. Please confirm to record it. Confirm
What VERIDIAN is not
### Said plainly, so you can trust the rest.
Not a law firm. It is software, not legal advice.
Not a certifier. No DPDP certification exists in India and we do not offer one.
No promised outcome. It helps you do and prove the work. It does not promise a result.
Not a document store. It never stores your documents.
### What VERIDIAN (VERy INDIAN) is
dpdp.veridian-aios.com is Indian software for running DPDP compliance, purpose-built for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, for CA, CS, audit and legal firms, their clients, and companies, institutions, schools and NGOs.
Who it is for:
1. CA, CS, audit and legal firms · their clients
2. Companies, institutions, schools and NGOs
- It turns the law into a list of jobs, gives each job to the responsible person, and coordinates every stakeholder — owners, staff, vendors, group companies — through one email a week, with no accounts or passwords.
- Each answer is recorded with a date and cannot be edited, building the proof an organisation needs.
- Every job is mapped to its legal source, including the SPDI Rules 2011 that apply until 13 May 2027.
It is not a law firm, does not certify (no DPDP certification exists in India), does not guarantee compliance, and never stores documents.

🗄️ We keep no documents We keep a fingerprint, a name and a date. The file stays with you.
### What we do, and where we stop
✅ We do Turn the Act into jobs · Give each job to a person · Chase the answers · Keep a dated record
🚫 We do not Touch your systems · Keep your documents · Give legal advice · Certify you as compliant · Promise that nobody will be fined
### Questions people ask
Do you touch our systems?
No. We do not connect to your software, read your files or install anything. We record what you tell us.
Do you keep our documents?
No. We keep a fingerprint, a name and a date. The document stays with you, so keep your own originals.
Can you certify us as compliant?
No. There is no government DPDP certification in India. We help you do the work and keep the record.
What if we stop paying?
Your record stays readable and can be exported. You lose new entries, not old ones.
Has anyone been fined yet?
No penalty order has been issued in India to date. The date to prepare for is 13 May 2027.

### Questions people ask
We are small. Does this apply to us?
Yes. There is no size exemption in the Act. A ten-person firm holding customer phone numbers is a Data Fiduciary.
Do you touch our systems?
No. We do not connect to your software, read your files or install anything. We record what you tell us.
Do you keep our documents?
No. We keep a fingerprint, a name and a date. The document stays with you, so keep your own originals.
Can you certify us as compliant?
No. There is no government DPDP certification in India. We help you do the work and keep the record.
Has anyone been fined yet?
No penalty order has been issued in India to date. The date to prepare for is 13 May 2027.
Do we need a special email address?
No. Sign-in is a link to whatever address you use: Gmail, Yahoo or your own domain.

## About VERIDIAN — https://veridian-aios.com/about/

### About VERIDIAN
### What VERIDIAN (VERy INDIAN) is
dpdp.veridian-aios.com is Indian software for running DPDP compliance, purpose-built for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025, for CA, CS, audit and legal firms, their clients, and companies, institutions, schools and NGOs.
Who it is for:
1. CA, CS, audit and legal firms · their clients
2. Companies, institutions, schools and NGOs
- It turns the law into a list of jobs, gives each job to the responsible person, and coordinates every stakeholder — owners, staff, vendors, group companies — through one email a week, with no accounts or passwords.
- Each answer is recorded with a date and cannot be edited, building the proof an organisation needs.
- Every job is mapped to its legal source, including the SPDI Rules 2011 that apply until 13 May 2027.
It is not a law firm, does not certify (no DPDP certification exists in India), does not guarantee compliance, and never stores documents.
About VERIDIAN
### Key dates
Every CA firm whose clients hold personal data will need to show DPDP compliance by 13 May 2027 — VERIDIAN is built for exactly that work.
- until 13 May 2027: The SPDI Rules 2011 are in force and apply.
- from 13 May 2027: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the DPDP Rules 2025 are in force. DPDP compliance is due.
### Where the data is
- The database is in Mumbai, India (Supabase, AWS region ap-south-1).
- Email is sent through Resend, a US company, so the content of every email passes through a US company's service.
- The public website is served by Cloudflare Pages, a global content delivery network.
### Your own AI assistant
Users can give their own AI assistant a private, time-limited AI work link from inside VERIDIAN.

## Become a Sales Partner — https://veridian-aios.com/partner/

### Become a Sales Partner
Tell CA, CS, audit and legal firms, companies, institutions, schools and NGOs about VERIDIAN. When an organisation you referred pays, you earn a commission.
Become a Sales Partner
You sign in with your email. We send you a link. There is no password.
Read the Sales Partner terms
### Who can be a Sales Partner
Anyone with a VERIDIAN sign-in. You do not need an organisation of your own. It is free to join.
### How to join
1. Sign in at /app/ with your email.
2. Open Sales Partner. It is in the bar at the top of your page. If you have no organisation yet, it is on the "Open your organisation" screen.
3. Read the Sales Partner terms and accept them. We record the version and the date.
4. Add your UPI id or your bank details, so that we can pay you.
- When both are done, you are an active partner and your personal link appears.
- Your code stays the same every time. The link opens our public website. It holds your code and nothing else.
### What happens when someone you referred pays
1. A person opens an organisation in VERIDIAN with your code. We note that you referred them.
2. The organisation pays us.
3. We see the money and confirm the payment by hand. Until then, no commission is created.
4. Your commission is created. It shows as waiting.
- You earn 20% of each yearly payment, including every yearly renewal, for as long as that client stays.
- Your own organisation, and any organisation you belong to, never counts. If you sign up through your own link, you earn nothing.
- A sign-up through your link counts while your status is active.
### How and when you are paid
A commission becomes payable 30 days after we confirm the client's payment.
We pay once a month, on the 10th, for everything that became payable before the end of the month before.
If your balance is under Rs 500, it carries forward to the next month.
We pay by UPI or bank transfer, to the details you gave us. We mark each commission paid after we send the money.
Tax (TDS) is deducted where the law requires it and shown on your statement.
These are the current terms. We may change them with 30 days' notice.
### Your dashboard and your statement
- You see how many organisations signed up, how many are in their free trial and how many pay. We show counts, never names.
- You see what you have earned, what is waiting, what is payable and what was paid.
- You get a statement by email on the 11th of each month. You can also download any month as a file. It shows gross, TDS and net.
### What we never do
- We never tell you the name of an organisation you referred.
- We never show your payout details in full, and we never put them in an email.
- We never create a commission before we have seen the client's money.
- We never ask you to pay to join.
### Please note
We cannot promise that you will earn anything. What you earn depends on whom you refer and whether they pay.
We do not give tax advice. For a question about a payout or about tax, write to us with the subject "Partner".
### Contact
- Write to dpdp@veridian-aios.com and put the topic in the subject: Grievance, Data request, Sales or Partner
- Grievance Officer: dpdp@veridian-aios.com (subject: Grievance)

## Sales Partner terms — https://veridian-aios.com/partner/terms/

### Sales Partner terms
Version 1.0. In force from 1 October 2026. We may change these terms with 30 days' notice.
These terms are the agreement between you and us when you become a VERIDIAN Sales Partner. They are short and in plain English.
### Who we are
In these terms, "we" and "us" mean Shobha Kamal Solutions Private Limited, the company that runs VERIDIAN DPDP. "You" means the person who accepts these terms.
### Joining
Anyone with a VERIDIAN sign-in can join. It is free.
You join by accepting these terms in the app and by giving us your payout details. We record the version you accepted and when.
When both are done, you are an active partner. Until then, your status is "applied" and a sign-up through your code does not count.
You are an independent partner. You are not our employee, agent or representative. You cannot sign anything for us or promise anything for us. You may work with others too.
### What you may say
- You may say what VERIDIAN is and does, in the words of our public pages.
- You may share your personal link.
- Tell the truth. Do not say that VERIDIAN gives legal advice, certifies anyone as compliant, or promises that nobody will be fined.
- Do not invent prices, discounts, offers or results. Send people to our public pages for what is true.
- Do not say that you speak for us.
### What you must not do
- No spam. Do not send messages in bulk to people who did not ask for them, by email, SMS or WhatsApp.
- Do not sign up through your own code, or through the code of anyone acting for you, to earn a commission on yourself.
- Do not create fake sign-ups or fake organisations.
- Do not collect personal data about the people you refer on our behalf.
- Do not pay to advertise using our name or brand.
### How commission is earned
- You earn 20% of each yearly payment from an organisation you referred, including every yearly renewal, for as long as that organisation stays a client.
- If an organisation pays by the month, you earn 5% of its first confirmed monthly payment. Nothing is earned on later months.
- A commission exists after we have seen the money and confirmed the payment by hand. We do not create a commission before that.
- The percentage is taken on the amount we confirm.
- You earn nothing on an organisation you own or belong to.
- A sign-up counts while your status is active. If your status is paused or ended when a payment is confirmed, no commission is created for that payment.
- If a payment is refunded or reversed before we pay the commission on it, we cancel that commission.
### When and how you are paid
- A commission becomes payable 30 days after we confirm the client's payment.
- We pay once a month, on the 10th, for everything that became payable before the end of the month before. If the 10th is not a working day, we pay on the next working day.
- If your balance is under Rs 500, it carries forward to the next month.
- We pay by UPI or bank transfer, to the details you gave us. Keep them correct. We do not pay to details you did not give us.
- You get an email when we pay, with the reference number of the payment.
### Tax
Tax (TDS) is deducted where the law requires it and shown on your statement.
Your statement shows gross, TDS and net for every commission.
You are responsible for your own tax on what you earn. We do not give tax advice.
### Your statement and your data
- We email you a statement on the 11th of each month. You can also download any month in the app.
- We keep your payout details to pay you and for no other use. We show them to you masked. We never put them in an email or in a link.
- We show you counts of the organisations you referred. We never show you their names or any of their personal data.
### How long this lasts, and ending it
- These terms start when you become an active partner and continue until one of us ends them.
- You can end them at any time. Write to us with the subject "Partner".
- We can pause or end them at any time. If you break these terms, we can do it at once and hold back the commission linked to the breach.
- If we pause or end them, you earn no commission on payments we confirm after that date.
- While your partnership is paused, we hold your payouts. When it ends, a commission that already exists is still paid, on the dates above.
### Changes
We may change these terms and the payout terms. We will tell you by email at least 30 days before a change takes effect.
We may ask you to accept the new version in the app. If you do not agree, you can end the partnership before the change takes effect.
### Law
These terms are governed by the laws of India. If we disagree, write to us first. We will try in good faith to settle it within 30 days. After that, the dispute clause in our Terms of Service applies.
### The company
SHOBHA KAMAL SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED, incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 2013.

## Your DPDP AI Assistant — https://veridian-aios.com/ai-assistant/

### Your free DPDP AI assistant
It does the routine work. You stay in charge.
It reads your jobs, answers your questions and drafts the updates. You confirm what counts.
Get your free AI assistant
You sign in with your email. We send you a link. There is no password.
### How you get it
1. Sign in with your email.
2. In the app, open your AI work link and press Copy link. You choose how long it lasts, 1, 7 or 30 days. The same link comes in your Monday email.
3. Paste it into your own AI assistant.
4. Say what you want. For example, "What is late, and who should I chase?"
### What it can do
- Read your jobs and answer your questions about them.
- Explain a job in plain English, with the law behind it.
- Write a status note or a reminder for you to send.
- Draft an update, such as marking a job done. You confirm it on your own page before anything changes.
- If you switch it on when you make the link, make small changes straight away. These are a note, a due date, who a job is given to, or not applicable. Each can be undone for 24 hours.
### What it cannot do
- It cannot send email or messages for you.
- A chat that just reads web pages cannot save changes. It will say so and tell you what to do by hand.
- It cannot decide for you. Anything with legal weight is a draft that you confirm.
- It cannot sign in for you, and it cannot see another organisation's data.
- It is not legal advice. For a legal question, ask your CA or a lawyer.
### What it costs
We charge nothing for the AI work link. We run no AI for it.
Your own AI account, and what it costs to use, is between you and that provider.
### You stay in charge
- The AI can read your jobs, and the names or emails of the people on them. Give the link to an AI you trust, and to nobody else. You can hide other people's emails when you make it.
- The link expires on its own, and you can switch it off at any time.
- Every change is written to your history, with a note that an AI assistant made it.
### Contact
- Write to dpdp@veridian-aios.com and put the topic in the subject: Grievance, Data request, Sales or Partner
- Grievance Officer: dpdp@veridian-aios.com (subject: Grievance)
Get your free AI assistant

Who it is for:
1. CA, CS, audit and legal firms · their clients
2. Companies, institutions, schools and NGOs
- It turns the law into a list of jobs, gives each job to the responsible person, and coordinates every stakeholder — owners, staff, vendors, group companies — through one email a week, with no accounts or passwords.
- Each answer is recorded with a date and cannot be edited, building the proof an organisation needs.
- Every job is mapped to its legal source, including the SPDI Rules 2011 that apply until 13 May 2027.
It is not a law firm, does not certify (no DPDP certification exists in India), does not guarantee compliance, and never stores documents.
